_purpose: CTTX opportunity learning loop. Every completed or progressing opportunity appends/updates one entry. Read by /opportunity-discovery and /opportunity-business-case before research. Improves the machine while the machine keeps running - never gates prospecting.

_schema.opportunity: Customer / property name (matches Notion CTTX Pipeline record)
_schema.industry_problem: The industry-level problem this customer experiences
_schema.business_outcome: Outcome the private network improves, in the customer's terms
_schema.operational_signal: What in public information pointed to the opportunity
_schema.network_pattern: Conceptual topology, e.g. carrier feed -> hilltop relay -> PtMP to blocks/packhouse
_schema.carrier_private_relationship: How existing/proposed carrier service feeds the private network
responses: Response that worked / did not work
_schema.decision_maker: Role (not personal details) of the person who decides
artefacts: Links to business case, Notion record
lessons: What should change in the next opportunity

entries.industry: NOT VERIFIED - capture from source business case
entries.industry_problem: NOT CAPTURED - source document not located in Notion/Drive/Gmail on 2026-10-01
lessons: Reference pattern: six-section business case (outcome drivers, operational journey, what changes, network concept, how it connects, how CTTX starts and proves it) with Private Infrastructure Network Assessment as CTA.
